values: 一名擅长生成多种召唤物的战士，能够利用召唤物持续制造伤害。
A warrior adept at summoning various creatures to continuously deal damage.
每一次成长都值得庆祝
Every bit of growth is worth celebrating.
What kind of flower will bloom this time?
(Miss Florabelle! Miss Florabelle! Miss Florabelle!) Hey, be good! Hey! Pretty lively, aren't they?
今天大家也很有活力呢。
心情不好的时候，看看美景，就会快乐起来。
If you're in a bad mood, maybe some beautiful scenery will cheer you up.
多好的礼物，那三个小家伙会抢着要均分。不过，这也是甜蜜的烦恼呢。
What a sweet gift! The children will love it!
哎呀，这是送给我的吗？我会好好收藏的哦~
Oh my, is this for me? I'll cherish it!
Phew, the kids are done with school today.
One can't have too many snacks.
Look, it's the Yuletide tree and a star on top!
Time to prepare gifts for the children.
Are the lanterns all set and ready?
“老师经常让我们保护好自己，但是，老师也需要人保护呀！我们可以保护她！”勇敢的花灵如是说。
"Miss Florabelle always tells us to take care of ourselves, but hey, she needs looking after too, right? We've got her back!" —Brave bulbsprite.
“没有人见过老师生气的样子。但是我们都觉得，老师发起火会很可怕。”来自芙拉贝尔的往届学生。
"No one has ever seen Florabelle angry, but we all think it would be horrific when it happens." —A former student of Florabelle's.
芙拉贝尔中意清脆的铃声，经常在上课时间之外敲响上课铃，并引来学生的围观。
Florabelle loves the crisp sound of tinkling bells. She often rings the class bell outside school hours, attracting crowds of students.
“我觉得我已经算擅长和人打交道的了……但我从来不懂她脑子里在想什么。”莱卡说起芙拉贝尔时总是有些挫败。
"I thought I was pretty good at dealing with people... But I can never understand what she's thinking." Lyca's voice is always tinged with a bit of frustration when she talks about Florabelle.
没人能猜到那个上学时总是迟到、早退、漏交作业的芙拉贝尔竟然留在学校成为了老师。
No one could have guessed that Florabelle, who frequently skipped classes and never did her homework, would end up staying after graduation and becoming a teacher at the Jade Lake Academy.
芙拉贝尔会若无其事地向不熟悉的人搭话，入学后一天内，她就熟知了学校内的管理层级，并为调皮的同学指出了逃课的正确方法。

Florabelle has always been able to strike up conversations with people she barely knows. On her first day, she became acquainted with the teachers and headmaster of the school and even taught some students the proper way to skip class.
据莱卡说，芙拉贝尔是自己认识的所有人里，最不在意占卜结果里坏运势的人。
According to Lyca, among all the people she knows, Florabelle is the least concerned with a bad divination.
“从来没见过老师惊慌失措的样子，好像什么事情都不会影响她的心情。”冷静的花灵如是说。
"I've never seen Miss Florabelle lose her cool. It seems that nothing can affect her mood." —Calm bulbsprite.
芙拉贝尔认为3是自己的幸运数字。
Florabelle considers the number 3 to be her lucky number.
胆怯的花灵经常躲在芙拉贝尔身后，羞于和别人打招呼。芙拉贝尔并没有强迫她，反而笑着说她能和伊温成为一对好朋友。

The shy bulbsprite often found refuge behind Florabelle, feeling too timid to greet others. Florabelle never pressured her, instead, she warmly reassured her, saying she could become great friends with Hewynn.
Phew, the kids are done with school today.
One can't have too many snacks.
Look, it's the Yuletide tree and a star on top!
Time to prepare gifts for the children.
Are the lanterns all set and ready?
伊温，听说塔兰村的人在村子里为你准备了一间满是鲜花的木屋？
Hewynn, I heard that the villagers of Taran prepared a house full of flowers for you in the village.
说起来，我还真怀念我上学的时候，最大的烦恼只是怎么学好功课而已。哪像现在……
Yeah, I really miss when I was in school. My biggest worry was my lessons, not like now...
洛桑 & 芙拉贝尔 & 莱卡
洛桑，真羡慕你能在伊索米亚各地游历。自从当了老师，我就再也没离开过瓦度索。
Lorsan, I envy you for being able to travel throughout Esperia. Since I became a teacher, I've never left Vaduso.
